notes.title: About got Banned in South Korea and Free Update
notes.notes:
Dear Korean players:
We're very sorry to inform you that Guardians of Eden is currently banned in South Korea and cannot be purchased anymore.
In order to facilitate players who have purchased the game,
we will change the free DLC expected to be released in June into a free update.
We would like to thank all of you again for the support and love for us. We will continue to work hard💪.

notes.title: Patch 0312 v.1.1
notes.notes:
Update:
Pressing default in settings won't change language.
Cum options in service after obtaining the Holy Scripture.
The Holy Scripture will be given after completing the game. 
Fix:
Pressing default in settings doesn't reset easy mode options.
Korean script dialogue.
Game will freeze on open if saved files are corrupted.
After NPC tutorial, merchant scrollbar isn't usable.
NPC pages leave buttons may be off-screen on wide monitors in fullscreen
